title: Security that understands
how everything connects.
description: Cyentific brings together cybersecurity research, knowledge engineering and standards-based automation to turn fragmented evidence into informed decisions and controlled action.
vision: Security tools should share more than data. They should share meaning: what an asset does, what depends on it, why a threat matters and which response is appropriate.
goal: Our goal is to shorten the path from finding a security issue to taking a justified course of action. Explicit knowledge models, inspectable evidence and practical limits on automation connect our product work, consultancy and open contributions.
